title: Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut to integrate AI-generated scenes into a larger…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut to integrate AI-generated scenes into a larger production timeline  
Use CapCut’s Green Screen workflow to composite Seedance-generated footage into other shots/backgrounds
